variants.en: The first nights in {village} were quiet in the way a held breath is quiet.
variants.fr: Les premieres nuits a {village} furent calmes comme un souffle retenu.

variants.en: Night fell on {village} early, and it did not seem in any hurry to leave.
variants.fr: La nuit tomba tot sur {village}, et elle ne semblait pas presse de partir.

variants.en: The lamps of {village} were lit at dusk. Nobody remembered lighting them.
variants.fr: Les lampes de {village} s'allumerent au crepuscule. Personne ne se souvenait de les avoir allumees.

variants.en: Fog came up from the harbour and settled over the roofs like a hand.
variants.fr: Le brouillard monta du port et se posa sur les toits comme une main.

variants.en: The shutters closed one by one along the street, each a little too soon.
variants.fr: Les volets se fermerent un par un le long de la rue, chacun un peu trop tot.

variants.en: The tide went out farther than the old charts allow, and the mud kept its secrets.
variants.fr: La maree se retira plus loin que ne le permettent les vieilles cartes, et la vase garda ses secrets.

variants.en: By now the nights in {village} had weight, and the dark pressed on the windows.
variants.fr: A present les nuits de {village} avaient du poids, et l'ombre pesait sur les fenetres.

variants.en: The dogs of {village} had stopped barking at the sea and begun to watch the streets.
variants.fr: Les chiens de {village} avaient cesse d'aboyer a la mer et surveillaient maintenant les rues.

variants.en: The night came on slowly, as though it were reading the village before it entered.
variants.fr: La nuit vint lentement, comme si elle lisait le village avant d'y entrer.

variants.en: Candles burned low in every window, and every flame leaned toward the water.
variants.fr: Les bougies brulaient bas a chaque fenetre, et chaque flamme se penchait vers l'eau.

variants.en: Doors that had once been left on the latch were barred, and no one explained why.
variants.fr: Les portes autrefois laissees au loquet furent verrouillees, et nul n'expliqua pourquoi.

variants.en: The cold of that night had a taste, like iron held in the mouth.
variants.fr: Le froid de cette nuit avait un gout, comme du fer garde dans la bouche.

variants.en: The last nights in {village} no longer felt like nights at all, only the same dark returning.
variants.fr: Les dernieres nuits a {village} ne ressemblaient plus a des nuits, seulement a la meme ombre qui revenait.

variants.en: The village held still. Even the gulls had gone, and the sky waited.
variants.fr: Le village ne bougeait plus. Meme les goelands etaient partis, et le ciel attendait.

variants.en: Every house in {village} seemed to face the same direction, though no one had turned them.
variants.fr: Chaque maison de {village} semblait regarder dans la meme direction, sans que personne ne les eut tournees.

variants.en: The night was thin as paper, and something moved behind it.
variants.fr: La nuit etait fine comme du papier, et quelque chose bougeait derriere.

variants.en: The sea had gone silent, which was worse than any storm.
variants.fr: La mer s'etait tue, ce qui etait pire que n'importe quelle tempete.

variants.en: The streets of {village} filled with a stillness that listened.
variants.fr: Les rues de {village} se remplirent d'un silence qui ecoutait.

variants.en: The tide came in twice before morning, the second time against the wind.
variants.fr: La maree monta deux fois avant le matin, la seconde contre le vent.

variants.en: The harbour rose and fell twice in one night, and the boats strained at ropes that held nothing.
variants.fr: Le port monta et descendit deux fois en une nuit, et les barques tirerent sur des cordes qui ne retenaient rien.

variants.en: Fishermen swore the water ran uphill past the breakwater, and the stones were wet at dawn.
variants.fr: Les pecheurs jurerent que l'eau remontait la pente passe la digue, et les pierres etaient mouillees a l'aube.

variants.en: The sea kept two timetables that night, and neither was the moon's.
variants.fr: La mer suivit deux horaires cette nuit-la, et aucun n'etait celui de la lune.

variants.en: Villagers watched the tide return before it had left.
variants.fr: Les villageois virent la maree revenir avant d'etre partie.

variants.en: The stars over {village} stood in a pattern no almanac records.
variants.fr: Les etoiles au-dessus de {village} formaient un dessin que nul almanach ne connait.

variants.en: The constellations had moved in the night, and nobody had seen them go.
variants.fr: Les constellations avaient bouge dans la nuit, et personne ne les avait vues partir.

variants.en: Villagers swore the stars glowed silver, then pale green, then went out one by one.
variants.fr: Les villageois jurerent que les etoiles brillaient d'argent, puis de vert pale, puis s'eteignaient une a une.

variants.en: A new star hung low over the cliffs, and it blinked as an eye does.
variants.fr: Une etoile nouvelle pendait bas au-dessus des falaises, et elle clignait comme un oeil.

variants.en: The sky showed a shape the old priests had a word for, and no one would say it.
variants.fr: Le ciel montra une forme pour laquelle les vieux pretres avaient un mot, et nul ne voulut le dire.

variants.en: The bells rang before dawn, and no rope was pulled.
variants.fr: Les cloches sonnerent avant l'aube, et aucune corde ne fut tiree.

variants.en: The church bell struck thirteen at midnight. The ringer was asleep across the square.
variants.fr: La cloche de l'eglise frappa treize coups a minuit. Le sonneur dormait de l'autre cote de la place.

variants.en: A single toll rolled across the roofs, and every dog in {village} lifted its head.
variants.fr: Un seul glas roula sur les toits, et tous les chiens de {village} leverent la tete.

variants.en: The bell spoke once in the dark. The clapper, when they checked, was bound with cobweb.
variants.fr: La cloche parla une fois dans le noir. Le battant, quand on le verifia, etait pris dans des toiles.

variants.en: Bronze sounded in the tower with no hand to move it, and the echo lasted too long.
variants.fr: Le bronze sonna dans la tour sans main pour le mouvoir, et l'echo dura trop longtemps.

variants.en: The water turned black as ink at the harbour wall and stayed black until dawn.
variants.fr: L'eau devint noire comme de l'encre au pied de la digue et le resta jusqu'a l'aube.

variants.en: A dark stain spread through the harbour, and the gulls refused to land on it.
variants.fr: Une tache sombre s'etendit dans le port, et les goelands refuserent de s'y poser.

variants.en: The sea went black at the edge of the quay, and the lamplight sank into it without a ripple.
variants.fr: La mer devint noire au bord du quai, et la lumiere des lampes y sombra sans une ride.

variants.en: Something dark rose through the harbour water, and the reflections stopped matching the sky.
variants.fr: Quelque chose de sombre monta dans l'eau du port, et les reflets cesserent de ressembler au ciel.

variants.en: The tide ran black and thick, and the nets came up smelling of old rooms.
variants.fr: La maree coula noire et epaisse, et les filets remonterent avec une odeur de vieilles chambres.

variants.en: {missing} vanished. The door at {home} was found open and the lamp still warm.
variants.fr: {missing} disparut. La porte de {home} fut trouvee ouverte, la lampe encore tiede.

variants.en: {missing} was gone by morning. Nobody at {home} had heard a door.
variants.fr: Au matin, {missing} avait disparu. Personne a {home} n'avait entendu une porte.

variants.en: {missing} vanished from {home}. The chair was still turned toward the window.
variants.fr: {missing} disparut de {home}. La chaise etait encore tournee vers la fenetre.

variants.en: {missing} did not come home. The village searched until the lanterns burned out.
variants.fr: {missing} ne rentra pas. Le village chercha jusqu'a ce que les lanternes s'eteignent.

variants.en: {missing} was taken in the night, or walked out of it. At {home} they set the table for two.
variants.fr: La nuit prit {missing}, ou {missing} en sortit a pied. A {home} on mit le couvert pour deux.

variants.en: {missing} was last seen near {home}, walking toward the water without a lantern.
variants.fr: On vit {missing} pour la derniere fois pres de {home}, marchant vers l'eau sans lanterne.

variants.en: People said they saw {who} among {cult}, chanting where the tide should not reach.
variants.fr: On dit avoir vu {who} parmi {cult}, a chanter la ou la maree ne devrait pas monter.

variants.en: Someone swore that {who} had joined {cult}, and the morning prayers sounded different after.
variants.fr: Quelqu'un jura que {who} avait rejoint {cult}, et les prieres du matin sonnerent autrement ensuite.

variants.en: It was whispered that {who} knelt with {cult} in a cellar that had no stairs.
variants.fr: On chuchota que {who} s'agenouillait avec {cult} dans une cave sans escalier.

variants.en: Smoke rose from the cliffs, and {who} was seen leaving it, with {cult} behind.
variants.fr: De la fumee monta des falaises, et on vit {who} en sortir, {cult} derriere.

variants.en: The villagers began to watch {who}, whose name now belonged to {cult}.
variants.fr: Les villageois se mirent a observer {who}, dont le nom appartenait desormais a {cult}.

variants.en: {who} was heard humming a hymn that only {cult} are said to know.
variants.fr: On entendit {who} fredonner un hymne que seuls {cult} sont censes connaitre.

variants.en: Word spread that {who} owed a debt to the men who row out at night.
variants.fr: Le bruit courut que {who} devait de l'argent aux hommes qui rament la nuit.

variants.en: The ledger was out. {who} had borrowed from the wrong boatmen, and everyone now knew.
variants.fr: Le registre fut expose. {who} avait emprunte aux mauvais bateliers, et tout le monde le savait.

variants.en: It came out that {who} had been paying the night rowers in silver and silence.
variants.fr: On apprit que {who} payait les rameurs de nuit en argent et en silence.

variants.en: The village learned what {who} had long hidden, a debt that no coin could settle.
variants.fr: Le village apprit ce que {who} cachait depuis longtemps, une dette qu'aucune piece ne pouvait solder.

variants.en: It was said that {who} slipped out after the last lamp to meet someone not a spouse.
variants.fr: On dit que {who} se glissait dehors apres la derniere lampe pour retrouver quelqu'un qui n'etait pas un conjoint.

variants.en: The shutters told the story: {who} had been seen at a back door long after dark.
variants.fr: Les volets racontaient l'histoire : on avait vu {who} a une porte de derriere bien apres la nuit.

variants.en: The village knew now where {who} went after midnight, and with whom.
variants.fr: Le village savait maintenant ou allait {who} apres minuit, et avec qui.

variants.en: A scrap of ribbon and a late lamp gave away {who}, and gossip did the rest.
variants.fr: Un bout de ruban et une lampe tardive trahirent {who}, et les commeres firent le reste.

variants.en: A book the abbey ordered burned was found beneath the floor of {who}.
variants.fr: Un livre que l'abbaye avait ordonne de bruler fut trouve sous le plancher, chez {who}.

variants.en: It was learned that {who} had been reading by candle a book that should not exist.
variants.fr: On apprit que {who} lisait a la chandelle un livre qui ne devrait pas exister.

variants.en: The floorboards of {who} gave up a forbidden volume, and its margins were still wet.
variants.fr: Chez {who}, les lattes rendirent un volume interdit, et ses marges etaient encore humides.

variants.en: Rumor said that {who} kept a black book, and that the book kept {who}.
variants.fr: La rumeur disait que {who} gardait un livre noir, et que le livre gardait {who}.

variants.en: It came out that {who} had seen a body carried down to the water and told no one.
variants.fr: On apprit que {who} avait vu porter un corps jusqu'a l'eau sans en parler a personne.

variants.en: {who} finally admitted what was seen on the quay at night, and the village went quiet.
variants.fr: {who} avoua enfin ce qu'on avait vu sur le quai la nuit, et le village se tut.

variants.en: Someone had to say it, and it was {who}: a shape wrapped in sailcloth, carried to the tide.
variants.fr: Il fallait que quelqu'un le dise, et ce fut {who} : une forme enroulee de toile, portee a la maree.

variants.en: The old silence broke when {who} spoke of a burden carried down to the black water.
variants.fr: Le vieux silence se rompit quand {who} parla d'un fardeau porte vers l'eau noire.

variants.en: The truth about {who} came out: the call from the cliffs had been answered more than once.
variants.fr: La verite sur {who} fut connue : l'appel des falaises avait recu plus d'une reponse.

variants.en: Neighbors learned that {who} had walked to the cliffs on more nights than any would confess.
variants.fr: Les voisins apprirent que {who} etait alle aux falaises plus de nuits que quiconque l'avouerait.

variants.en: It was whispered that {who} kept faith with something older than the church.
variants.fr: On chuchota que {who} gardait foi en quelque chose de plus ancien que l'eglise.

variants.en: A salt-stained robe turned up at the door of {who}, and no explanation satisfied anyone.
variants.fr: Chez {who}, une robe tachee de sel apparut sur le seuil, et aucune explication ne satisfit personne.

variants.en: The old story changed in the telling. By the next door it had grown teeth.
variants.fr: La vieille histoire changea en etant racontee. D'une porte a l'autre elle avait pris des dents.

variants.en: A rumor that began as a whisper in {village} came back to its teller altered, and the teller did not recognize it.
variants.fr: Une rumeur nee d'un murmure a {village} revint a son conteur changee, et il ne la reconnut pas.

variants.en: What was said on one night was repeated on the next, and the facts slid a little farther each time.
variants.fr: Ce qui fut dit une nuit fut repete la suivante, et les faits glissaient un peu plus loin a chaque fois.

variants.en: The tale passed from mouth to mouth and learned new details no one had witnessed.
variants.fr: Le conte passa de bouche en bouche et apprit des details que personne n'avait vus.

variants.en: Gossip had rewritten itself overnight, and every version insisted that it was the original.
variants.fr: Les commerages s'etaient reecrits pendant la nuit, et chaque version pretendait etre l'originale.

variants.en: {who} nodded to you in the street, and the old quarrel seemed to have been put down for good.
variants.fr: {who} vous salua dans la rue, et l'ancienne querelle semblait deposee pour de bon.

variants.en: Even {who} had softened. The bitter words were no longer repeated.
variants.fr: Meme {who} s'etait adouci. Les mots amers n'etaient plus repetes.

variants.en: {who} spoke of you kindly, as someone does who has decided to let a grievance drown.
variants.fr: {who} parlait de vous avec bonte, comme quelqu'un qui a decide de laisser se noyer une rancune.

variants.en: The accusation was not forgotten, but {who} had chosen to carry it lightly.
variants.fr: L'accusation n'etait pas oubliee, mais {who} avait choisi de la porter legerement.

variants.en: {who} flinched when you passed, and watched the shadows behind you.
variants.fr: {who} sursauta a votre passage, et surveilla les ombres derriere vous.

variants.en: The walls held what {who} had been told, and {who} no longer trusted a kind word.
variants.fr: Les murs gardaient ce que {who} avait entendu, et {who} ne croyait plus aux mots aimables.

variants.en: {who} locked the door twice and spoke through the crack, as if you were the sea.
variants.fr: {who} ferma la porte a double tour et parla par la fente, comme si vous etiez la mer.

variants.en: {who} kept looking over a shoulder, and the village began to do the same.
variants.fr: {who} regardait sans cesse par-dessus l'epaule, et le village se mit a faire de meme.

variants.en: {who} stood by you, and said so aloud, which in {village} takes courage.
variants.fr: {who} resta de votre cote, et le dit tout haut, ce qui demande du courage a {village}.

variants.en: A lamp was left burning in the window of {who}, and everyone understood for whom.
variants.fr: Chez {who}, une lampe restait allumee a la fenetre, et chacun comprit pour qui.

variants.en: {who} remembered your kindness and repaid it with a door that opened without knocking.
variants.fr: {who} se souvenait de votre bonte et la rendit par une porte qui s'ouvrait sans qu'on frappe.

variants.en: {who} would hear no ill of you, and said as much to those who tried.
variants.fr: {who} ne voulait entendre aucun mal de vous, et le dit a ceux qui essayaient.

variants.en: {who} spoke only of what was seen at the water, and had stopped sleeping.
variants.fr: {who} ne parlait plus que de ce qu'on avait vu pres de l'eau, et ne dormait plus.

variants.en: {who} pored over clues until the candle drowned in its own wax.
variants.fr: {who} se pencha sur les indices jusqu'a ce que la chandelle se noie dans sa cire.

variants.en: The eyes of {who} were bright and wrong, fixed on something just behind the village.
variants.fr: {who} avait les yeux brillants et faux, fixes sur quelque chose juste derriere le village.

variants.en: {who} drew the same symbol over and over, and could not say where it came from.
variants.fr: {who} dessinait sans cesse le meme signe, et ne savait dire d'ou il venait.

variants.en: Nothing was learned. The village kept its counsel and the dark kept its own.
variants.fr: On n'apprit rien. Le village garda son conseil et l'ombre garda le sien.

variants.en: No one spoke of the night after, which is its own kind of speech.
variants.fr: Nul ne parla de la nuit ensuite, ce qui est une facon de parler.

variants.en: The streets were empty by dusk, and the quiet felt rehearsed.
variants.fr: Les rues etaient vides des le crepuscule, et le calme semblait repete.

variants.en: Nothing happened that anyone would admit to.
variants.fr: Il ne se passa rien que quelqu'un voulut admettre.

variants.en: The villagers told you nothing, and their silences grew longer than their words.
variants.fr: Les villageois ne vous dirent rien, et leurs silences devinrent plus longs que leurs mots.

variants.en: Whatever moved in the night left no mark that anyone would point to.
variants.fr: Quoi qu'il ait bouge dans la nuit, nul ne voulut en montrer la trace.

variants.en: The night passed and the village wore its ordinary face, badly.
variants.fr: La nuit passa et le village porta son visage ordinaire, mal.

variants.en: There was no word of it by morning, and the lack of words was louder than a bell.
variants.fr: On n'en dit mot au matin, et ce manque de mots resonnait plus fort qu'une cloche.

variants.en: No one would say what had happened. They looked at the sea instead.
variants.fr: Nul ne voulut dire ce qui s'etait passe. On regarda la mer a la place.

variants.en: The night gave up nothing, and the village seemed to have expected that.
variants.fr: La nuit ne livra rien, et le village semblait s'y attendre.

variants.en: Even the whispers had gone, as though the village were listening for the next.
variants.fr: Meme les murmures avaient cesse, comme si le village ecoutait le suivant.

variants.en: Nothing was learned, and you felt that it was being watched not to be learned.
variants.fr: On n'apprit rien, et vous sentiez qu'on veillait a ce que rien ne soit appris.

variants.en: No bodies were found, but {missing} was mourned all the same, and a candle was lit at the quay.
variants.fr: On ne trouva aucun corps, mais on pleura {missing} quand meme, et une chandelle fut allumee au quai.

variants.en: {missing} was given to the ground, or to the water. The village agreed to call it rest.
variants.fr: On rendit {missing} a la terre, ou a l'eau. Le village convint d'appeler cela le repos.

variants.en: In the end {missing} lay still, and the sea took the name along with the rest.
variants.fr: A la fin {missing} reposa, et la mer prit le nom avec le reste.

variants.en: The truth was as cold as it was plain: {missing} would not be coming back.
variants.fr: La verite etait aussi froide que simple : {missing} ne reviendrait pas.

variants.en: {missing} got out. Past the last road a door stood open, and no one here will be told which.
variants.fr: {missing} a pu partir. Passe la derniere route une porte etait ouverte, et nul ici ne saura laquelle.

variants.en: A letter with no stamp suggested that {missing} was alive somewhere the village was not.
variants.fr: Une lettre sans timbre laissait entendre que {missing} vivait la ou le village n'etait pas.

variants.en: {missing} walked away from {village} and did not look back, and the road forgave it.
variants.fr: {missing} s'eloigna de {village} sans se retourner, et la route le lui pardonna.

variants.en: It was whispered that {missing} had boarded a ship that left at an hour no ship leaves.
variants.fr: On chuchota que {missing} avait embarque sur un navire parti a une heure ou nul navire ne part.

variants.en: {missing} answered the call of the cliffs, and now sings with those who keep the old hours.
variants.fr: {missing} repondit a l'appel des falaises, et chante maintenant avec ceux qui gardent les heures anciennes.

variants.en: {missing} was not taken but chosen, and wears the salt-stained robe with calm.
variants.fr: Personne ne prit {missing} : la secte l'appela, et {missing} porte la robe tachee de sel avec calme.

variants.en: A voice that sounded like {missing} was heard in the chanting, steady and unafraid.
variants.fr: Une voix qui ressemblait a {missing} fut entendue dans le chant, ferme et sans peur.

variants.en: {missing} belongs to them now, and the cult does not give its own back.
variants.fr: {missing} leur appartient maintenant, et la secte ne rend pas les siens.

variants.en: {missing} came back wrong. Something wore the face and walked as {missing} had walked.
variants.fr: Au retour, {missing} etait autre. Quelque chose portait le visage et marchait comme {missing} marchait.

variants.en: {missing} changed, and the village learned to cross the street instead of say so.
variants.fr: {missing} changea, et le village apprit a traverser la rue plutot que de le dire.

variants.en: What stands in the doorway at {home} is not {missing}, though it answers to the name.
variants.fr: Ce qui se tient sur le seuil de {home} n'est pas {missing}, bien que cela reponde au nom.

variants.en: The tide kept {missing} and returned something else, patient and very polite.
variants.fr: La maree garda {missing} et rendit autre chose, patient et tres poli.

variants.en: {missing} was hiding, somewhere the lamps do not reach, and the village was too afraid to look.
variants.fr: {missing} se cachait, quelque part ou les lampes n'atteignent pas, et le village avait trop peur pour chercher.

variants.en: Behind a wall or beneath a floor, {missing} lived on in the dark and waited.
variants.fr: Derriere un mur ou sous un plancher, {missing} vivait dans le noir et attendait.

variants.en: {missing} was still in {village}, just out of sight, watching the street through a crack.
variants.fr: {missing} etait encore a {village}, juste hors de vue, a regarder la rue par une fente.

variants.en: A scratch of movement in the cellar suggested that {missing} had never really left.
variants.fr: Un frottement dans la cave laissa entendre que {missing} n'etait jamais vraiment parti.

variants.en: {missing} was displaced, pushed out of the hours the village keeps, and wanders those hours still.
variants.fr: Les heures que le village garde chasserent {missing}, qui les erre encore.

variants.en: The omens touched {missing}, and the world slid sideways, out of time.
variants.fr: Les presages toucherent {missing}, et le monde glissa de cote, hors du temps.

variants.en: {missing} is somewhere between one night and the next, and the clocks of {village} disagree.
variants.fr: {missing} est quelque part entre une nuit et la suivante, et les horloges de {village} se contredisent.

variants.en: Nobody saw {missing} go. The place where {missing} stood simply stopped being there.
variants.fr: Nul ne vit partir {missing}. L'endroit ou se tenait {missing} cessa simplement d'etre la.

variants.en: {missing} was taken. That much the village will say, and no more.
variants.fr: On prit {missing}. Cela, le village veut bien le dire, et rien de plus.

variants.en: {missing} is gone, and the way of it is a door nobody has yet found.
variants.fr: {missing} n'est plus la, et la facon est une porte que nul n'a encore trouvee.

variants.en: {missing} was taken from {village}. What happened after belongs to the dark.
variants.fr: On prit {missing} a {village}. Ce qui suivit appartient a l'ombre.

variants.en: The name of {missing} is spoken softly now, and the end of the sentence is never given.
variants.fr: Le nom de {missing} se dit doucement maintenant, et la fin de la phrase n'est jamais donnee.

variants.en: This is the chronicle of {village}, as far as anyone would tell it.
variants.fr: Voici la chronique de {village}, autant que quiconque ait voulu la raconter.

variants.en: The record of {village} is incomplete, and the missing pages are the point.
variants.fr: Le registre de {village} est incomplet, et les pages manquantes en sont le sens.

variants.en: What follows is what was learned in {village}, and nothing that was not.
variants.fr: Ce qui suit est ce qu'on apprit a {village}, et rien de ce qu'on n'apprit pas.

variants.en: {village} kept its own account of those nights, and this is the copy that survives.
variants.fr: {village} tint son propre compte de ces nuits, et ceci en est la copie qui subsiste.

variants.en: Fates never learned: {count}. The village never offered them.
variants.fr: Destins jamais connus : {count}. Le village ne les offrit jamais.

variants.en: Pages left blank for the missing: {count}. The blank is not empty.
variants.fr: Pages laissees blanches pour les disparus : {count}. Le blanc n'est pas vide.

variants.en: Names left without an ending: {count}, which may be the cruelest ending.
variants.fr: Noms laisses sans fin : {count}, ce qui est peut-etre la fin la plus cruelle.

variants.en: Missing and unanswered: {count}. The sea keeps them company.
variants.fr: Disparus restes sans reponse : {count}. La mer leur tient compagnie.

variants.en: Whispers named the cults' faithful: {count}, and more were suspected.
variants.fr: Les murmures nommerent des fideles des sectes : {count}, et d'autres furent soupconnes.

variants.en: Villagers seen among the cults: {count}, kneeling where the tide should not reach.
variants.fr: Villageois vus parmi les sectes : {count}, agenouilles la ou la maree ne devrait pas monter.

variants.en: Cult members you learned of: {count}. The true number is a locked door.
variants.fr: Fideles des sectes connus de vous : {count}. Le vrai nombre est une porte close.

variants.en: Singers with the cults you heard of: {count}. You wondered who else had learned the hymn.
variants.fr: Chanteurs des sectes dont vous entendites parler : {count}. Vous vous demandates qui d'autre savait l'hymne.

variants.en: Omens told: {count}. Each one made the next easier to believe.
variants.fr: Presages racontes : {count}. Chacun rendit le suivant plus facile a croire.

variants.en: Warnings from the sky and the sea: {count}. The village understood none of them in time.
variants.fr: Avertissements du ciel et de la mer : {count}. Le village n'en comprit aucun a temps.

variants.en: Signs reported: {count}. The order they came in seemed deliberate.
variants.fr: Signes rapportes : {count}. Leur ordre d'arrivee semblait voulu.

variants.en: Omens you learned of: {count}. You learned also that the village had been counting.
variants.fr: Presages dont vous apprites l'existence : {count}. Vous apprites aussi que le village comptait.

variants.en: Very little was learned, and what was learned felt like a courtesy.
variants.fr: On apprit tres peu, et ce qu'on apprit ressemblait a une politesse.

variants.en: The village told you almost nothing, and it was watching to see what you made of it.
variants.fr: Le village ne vous dit presque rien, et regarda ce que vous en feriez.

variants.en: You leave {village} knowing little, and the little is enough to keep you awake.
variants.fr: Vous quittez {village} en sachant peu, et ce peu suffit a vous garder eveille.

variants.en: The chronicle is thin. The silence around it is thick, and it is the part that watched.
variants.fr: La chronique est mince. Le silence autour est epais, et c'est lui qui regardait.

variants.en: The shape of the story is visible now, and it does not look back at you kindly.
variants.fr: La forme de l'histoire est visible maintenant, et elle ne vous regarde pas avec bonte.

variants.en: Enough was learned to be afraid with some precision.
variants.fr: On apprit assez pour avoir peur avec une certaine precision.

variants.en: You hold half a pattern, and {village} seems content to let you finish it alone.
variants.fr: Vous tenez la moitie d'un motif, et {village} semble content de vous laisser l'achever seul.

variants.en: What you learned fits together almost too well, and that is its own warning.
variants.fr: Ce que vous avez appris s'emboite presque trop bien, et c'est un avertissement en soi.

variants.en: The whole story lies open, and {village} knows that you have read it.
variants.fr: Toute l'histoire est ouverte, et {village} sait que vous l'avez lue.

variants.en: You understand now. The understanding does not feel like victory, only like being seen.
variants.fr: Vous comprenez maintenant. Comprendre ne ressemble pas a une victoire, seulement a etre vu.

variants.en: Nothing was hidden at the last, and the village waited to see what you would do with it.
variants.fr: Rien ne resta cache a la fin, et le village attendit de voir ce que vous en feriez.

variants.en: The chronicle is complete, and the final line has your name in it.
variants.fr: La chronique est complete, et la derniere ligne porte votre nom.
